itens.titulo: Inflation data, Bank of America's penalty, Apple's new home hub and more in Morning Squawk
itens.descricao: Inflation data, Bank of America's penalty, Apple's new home hub and more in Morning Squawk CNBC
trechos: The S&P 500 ended yesterday's session little changed.
Here's what to know: - Economists polled by Dow Jones expect headline CPI to rise 0.6% from August and 3.6% from a year ago.
- Ahead of today's data, New York Federal Reserve President John Williams told Bloomberg News he sees "disinflationary forces at play" and that the central bank may not have to raise rates in 2027.
- The S&P 500 has so far had a sleepy week while Wall Street awaited this morning's report.
Shares of Bank of America are more than 4% lower in premarket trading after the bank reported a steep drop in profit in the third quarter thanks to a $1.2 billion penalty from the U.S.
The penalty weighed heavily on Bank of America's earnings, cutting income by 17 cents a share.
Meanwhile, Morgan Stanley beat top- and bottom-line estimates this morning, posting equities trading revenue numbers that topped analysts' expectations by more than $900 million.
Bank of America's Moynihan and Morgan Stanley CEO Ted Pick will both join CNBC's "Squawk on the Street" today.

itens.titulo: Bitcoin Is Up 7.1% and Solana 5.3% This Month. Ethereum Is Down 0.7% and XRP 1.4%. What Separates Them?
itens.descricao: Bitcoin Is Up 7.1% and Solana 5.3% This Month. Ethereum Is Down 0.7% and XRP 1.4%. What Separates Them? Yahoo Finance
trechos: Quick Read - Bitcoin posts a 7.1% monthly gain and pulled in $176 million in ETF inflows on a single day, while Ethereum and XRP just dipped below zero.
- Weekly data flips the script: Solana drops 9.8% in seven days, casting doubt on whether its 5.3% monthly gain will hold.
- Bitcoin is the only coin attracting significant new ETF investment, with Solana bleeding outflows on 8 of 9 October trading days and XRP funds nearly frozen.
(Sponsor) Bitcoin (CRYPTO:BTC) is up 7.1% over the last 30 days, while Solana (CRYPTO:SOL) is up 5.3%.
In contrast, Ethereum (CRYPTO:ETH) is down 0.7%, and XRP (CRYPTO:XRP) is down 1.4%.
Just a day earlier, Ethereum's 30-day performance was up 0.8%, and XRP was up 1.3%.
The 30-day figure is a rolling measure that compares the current price to the price from exactly a month ago.

Each day, the starting point shifts, so if a coin had a strong performance a month ago, that higher price becomes the new baseline, causing the 30-day figure to decline even if the coin hasn't moved much recently.
